Found 18 items in registries @agents-ui:

- agent-disconnect-button (registry:component) - A button for disconnecting the agent session. [@agents-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- agent-track-control (registry:component) - A control for managing media tracks (microphone, camera, screen share) with appropriate icons and loading states. [@agents-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- agent-control-bar (registry:component) - A control bar for managing media tracks (microphone, camera, screen share), disconnecting the agent session, and opening the chat input, with appropriate icons and loading states. [@agents-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- agent-audio-visualizer-bar (registry:component) - A linear bar visualizer for audio tracks. [@agents-ui]

- agent-audio-visualizer-radial (registry:component) - A radial bar visualizer for audio tracks. [@agents-ui]

  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- agent-session-provider (registry:component) - A component for providing an agent's session context and ensuring remote participants’ audio tracks (microphones and screen share) are audible. [@agents-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- start-audio-button (registry:component) - A button for starting the agent session's audio track when the browser blocks audio playback. [@agents-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- agent-chat-indicator (registry:component) - A component for indicating the agent's chat status with a blinking dot. Useful for indicating the agent is thinking before generating a response. [@agents-ui]

- agent-chat-transcript (registry:component) - A component for displaying the agent session's chat transcript. [@agents-ui]

- agent-audio-visualizer-aura (registry:component) - An aura visualizer for audio tracks. [@agents-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- nextjs-api-token-route (registry:page) - A NextJS API route to generate a LiveKit session token while keeping your API keys private. [@agents-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- agent-session-view-01 (registry:block) - A full-screen agent session block with transcript, controls, and I/O media tiles. [@agents-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- agent-popup-01 (registry:block) - A floating chat-bubble trigger that expands into a compact agent session popup, suitable for embedding on any page. [@agents-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- all (registry:item) - Installs every component in the @agents-ui registry (excluding the nextjs-api-token-route). [@agents-ui]
